limitations: Ideal externally timed 1ohm gate-to-protection-rail switch is a diagnostic intervention, not a realizable trigger design.
Existing trigger circuitry and all external network components retained.
No ESD rating, thermal or transistor survival claim.
decision: Prioritize autonomous trigger/drive timing before enlarging the discharge device. Ideal timely gate assist substantially reduces positive core excursion, but residual voltage and off-state false-trigger behavior still require core coordination.
